clientId.title: Daikin Onecta Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of the application registered at https://developer.cloud.daikineurope.com.

clientSecret.title: Daikin Onecta Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client Secret of the application registered at https://developer.cloud.daikineurope.com.

refreshToken.title: Daikin Onecta Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token obtained by completing the authorization code flow once with your Developer Portal application.

tokenFile.title: Token File (optional)
tokenFile.description: Absolute path where the OAuth2 access/refresh tokens are persisted. Leave empty to store them in the Matterbridge data directory (recommended for Docker).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh device state from the Onecta cloud.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.
